requirements.evidence: Config key added (config/services.php:40 `'mention_id' => env('DISCORD_MENTION_ID')`); mention appended on its own line via `$suffix = ... "\n".$mention` (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:74); validation `'/^\d{17,20}\z/'` after trim, ints accepted, non-strings rejected (DiscordOpsAlert.php:43, 64-78) — no /u flag so \d is ASCII-only and \z blocks trailing-newline bypass; truncation reserves room: `mb_substr(..., 0, self::MaxContentLength - mb_strlen($suffix))` (line 76), unchanged at 1800 when no mention; send()/no-op/redaction/logging untouched; .env.example, devops.md and logging.md documented.

conventions.evidence: Change stays in the existing App\Ops\DiscordOpsAlert class with a private helper and a typed const matching siblings (`private const string SnowflakePattern`); docs kept in sync (docs/ops/devops.md:61,70, docs/ops/logging.md:83), CHANGELOG under [Unreleased] (CHANGELOG.md:12), class PHPDoc updated (DiscordOpsAlert.php:18-20); Pest tests added in the existing test file.

security.evidence: Strict anchored ASCII-digit whitelist with `\z` rejects `@everyone`, `123\n@everyone`, `123> \n@everyone`, trailing newline inside the value, non-ASCII digits, floats and arrays (DiscordOpsAlert.php:68-78); redaction and URL-free failure logging untouched.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php:136-151 covers string/trimmed/integer/17/20-digit valid IDs with exact content; :153-179 covers null, empty, blank, @everyone, @here, abc, 123, 16/21 digits, both injection strings from the task, trailing junk, non-ASCII digits, float, array; :181-194 asserts length is exactly 1800 and the mention survives truncation. Existing tests not modified.

simplicity.evidence: One small private `mention()` helper plus a three-line change to `formatContent` (DiscordOpsAlert.php:73-78); reuses the existing MaxContentLength constant and truncation; no new classes or abstractions.

readability.evidence: Clear names (`mention`, `$suffix`, `SnowflakePattern`), short docblock on the helper (line 61-63), early returns; style matches the surrounding class.

scope.evidence: Every touched file is required by the task (class, config, .env.example, both ops docs, tests) plus the CHANGELOG entry the conventions require; no unrelated edits or extras such as allowed_mentions or role mentions.

issues.explanation: There is no explicit test showing that a long alert with no mention configured is still exactly 1800 characters; the pre-existing truncation test probably covers this, but it is not visible in the diff.

review.summary: The change adds `services.discord.mention_id` and appends a strictly validated `<@id>` mention (ASCII-only 17-20 digits after trim, integers accepted) on its own final line. It reserves room for the mention within the 1800-character limit and updates the env example, ops docs, changelog and PHPDoc. Thorough Pest tests cover valid, invalid/injection and truncation cases. The change is lean and correct, and I would approve it as is.
